mapper.select: SELECT c.*, u.username, u.real_name, u.`role` AS role FROM ticket_comment c INNER JOIN `user` u ON u.id = c.user_id WHERE c.ticket_id = #{ticketId} AND c.deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.create_time ASC, c.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ticket_comment (ticket_id, user_id, parent_id, content, create_time, update_time, deleted) VALUES (#{ticketId}, #{userId}, #{parentId}, #{content}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
